name: generated-notebook-ui-assets-v1
promptSummary: Blank reusable hand-drawn parchment UI elements for the illustrated parish notebook interface. No text, no portraits, no scene content.

cropNotes.topBanner: Wide blank strip from top of generated sheet.
cropNotes.peopleRail: Tall left rail with six blank oval portrait apertures.
cropNotes.notebookPage: Large spiral-bound blank notebook page with clip.
cropNotes.actionCards: Three blank square cards; repeat/rotate for five action slots.
cropNotes.smallCards: Two blank small cards suitable for map/time controls.
cropNotes.activeIntentsCard: Medium blank note card with two punched holes.
